gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is named for doctoral applicants on the pages checked.

supervisor.value: The confirmation of a supervisor must be available for admission, and every professor of the faculty can supervise.
supervisor.quote: Furthermore, the confirmation of a supervisor of the dissertation must be available for admission.

also.quote: All professors of the Faculty of Civil and Environmental Engineering can act as supervisors.

funding.value: TU Wien's Doctoral Center offers no doctoral scholarships, and salaried Prae-Doc positions are advertised only from time to time.
funding.quote: Unfortunately, the Doctoral Center does not offer scholarships for doctoral candidates.

also.quote: new positions for doctoral candidates at TU Wien (Prae-Doc employment) may be advertised from time to time

entry_route.value: Admission is granted on completion of a qualifying master's or diploma programme.
entry_route.quote: Admission to a doctoral programme at the Faculty of Civil and Environmental Engineering is granted upon completion of a qualifying master's or diploma programme.

notes: The faculty page sets its own supervisor and master's rules (quoted). Environmental science and atmospheric or ocean fields were not saved; no separate environment PhD was found.
